title: Incident Reporting and Management Procedure
content:
SOP: Incident Reporting and Management Procedure (SOP-INC-001)
DEPARTMENT: Quality and Patient Safety
VERSION: 2.1
ROLES: all_staff
PURPOSE: Non-punitive adverse event reporting within 1 hour.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Incident Reporting and Management Procedure in full compliance with Quality and Patient Safety hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Incident Reporting and Management Procedure in full compliance with Quality and Patient Safety hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Incident Reporting and Management Procedure in full compliance with Quality and Patient Safety hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Incident Reporting and Management Procedure in full compliance with Quality and Patient Safety hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Incident Reporting and Management Procedure in full compliance with Quality and Patient Safety hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Quality and Patient Safety.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-INC-001 Incident Reporting and Management Procedure v2.1, Section 4
